categories.main_business_segments: CX Technology Corporation primarily operates in the manufacturing of high-end speaker components including magnetic poles, magnetic rings, magnetic seats, aluminum cones, metal and plastic speaker frames, grills, brackets, and magnetic circuit assemblies. The company also produces automotive, motorcycle, and bicycle forged and stamped parts, such as suspension rubber seats, engine oil control valve covers, brake pistons, timing belt tensioner shafts, motor magnetic yokes, and other metal and plastic components. Additionally, it has a financial securities business segment through its investment in Phu Hung Securities Corporation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in cold forging, precision stamping, plastic injection molding, assembly, and processing technologies. It has developed proprietary technologies such as groove forging for magnetic poles and seats, continuous forging and stamping processes, mold heat treatment to extend mold life, and a patented high-frequency copper sound cover riveting technology. It also employs CNC precision machining, hanging electroplating, and has introduced automation including continuous forging machines, NC robotic arms, automatic feeding machines, and automated plating lines. The company uses Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and RFID systems for production and inventory management, and has implemented IPQC visual inspection systems for quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CX Technology serves global top-tier automotive audio brands and professional speaker manufacturers, including B&W, Dynaudio, Harman, Mark Levinson, Pioneer, JBL, Bose, and others. Its products are widely used in automotive, consumer, professional audio, communication, and home appliance markets. The company also supplies forged and stamped parts to automotive, motorcycle, bicycle, industrial motor, and construction industries. Its financial securities business serves the Vietnamese market through Phu Hung Securities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities in Taiwan (headquarters), Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City and Hai Duong), and Shanghai, China. Its sales markets cover Asia, the Americas, and Europe, with Asia accounting for the majority of sales. It has established local sourcing and production to serve customers in Southeast Asia and China, and maintains a global customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: CX Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of key speaker components and automotive parts. It sources raw materials such as steel, aluminum, copper, and plastics from upstream suppliers and supplies finished components to downstream speaker manufacturers, automotive OEMs, and other industrial customers. It also engages in partial assembly of magnetic circuits for speakers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous process improvement, product innovation, and automation to enhance quality and reduce costs. R&D efforts include developing high-value forged and stamped products, cold and hot composite forging, aluminum forging, plastic-metal insert molding, and automated quality inspection systems. It emphasizes environmental sustainability with ISO14001 and ISO14064-1 certifications and aims for carbon neutrality. The company also invests in digitalization, ERP and APS systems, and collaborates with universities and research institutes for technology development.
categories.revenue_model: CX Technology generates revenue mainly through the sale of manufactured speaker components, automotive and industrial forged and stamped parts, and plastic injection molded products. It also earns income from its financial securities business via brokerage and investment services. Revenue is derived from product sales to global OEMs and aftermarket customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader and one of the largest manufacturers of high-end speaker components, holding about 20% global market share in automotive speaker components. It competes with other specialized forging and speaker component manufacturers worldwide. CX Technology differentiates itself through advanced manufacturing technologies, vertical integration, quality certifications (IATF16949, ISO9001, ISO14001), and strong customer relationships with premium audio brands. It faces competition from emerging low-cost producers in Southeast Asia and China but maintains a competitive edge through technology and quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal year 2024 (113th year), CX Technology reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$2.29 billion, a 1.06% increase from the previous year. Operating gross profit rose by 27.5% to NT$543 million, with a gross margin of 24%. Net income attributable to the company was NT$102.75 million, with earnings per share of NT$1.14. The company has shown steady growth and maintains a solid financial structure with total assets around NT$8.35 billion and shareholders' equity of NT$3.2 billion. Its subsidiary, Fu Chuan Precision Industry, experienced nearly 30% revenue growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CX Technology emphasizes high-quality, precision-engineered speaker components with proprietary forging and assembly technologies that enhance product durability and acoustic performance. Its vertical integration of forging, stamping, machining, plating, and assembly ensures tight quality control and reliable delivery. The company invests in automation and digitalization to improve efficiency and reduce costs. It also prioritizes environmental sustainability and compliance with international standards, appealing to premium global customers seeking advanced, eco-friendly audio components. Its broad product portfolio and ability to serve diverse markets including automotive, consumer electronics, and industrial sectors further differentiate it.
